subject: science
passage: The dragon's blood tree, which grows only on the island of Socotra off the coast of ______ has a shape unlike almost any other tree: its branches spread out and up to form a dense, flat-topped crown that looks like an open umbrella. The crown shades the ground beneath it and captures moisture from the fog that drifts over the island.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Which grows only on the island of Socotra off the coast of Yemen" is extra information about the tree. It opens with a comma after "tree," so it must close with a comma too, before the verb "has."
explanation.A: Incorrect. A semicolon can't separate the subject "The dragon's blood tree" from its verb "has."
explanation.B: Incorrect. Without a closing comma, the extra information is never set off and runs straight into the verb "has."
explanation.C: Incorrect. The extra information opens with a comma, so it can't close with a dash; the two marks must match.
explanation.D: Correct. The closing comma matches the opening comma after "tree" and completes the pair around the extra information.
